data.title: Zum Sees Strong Driver Hiring Momentum as More Than 200 Drivers and Families Celebrate New Philadelphia Operations Center
data.description: Celebrating a significant moment in its commitment to Philadelphia, Zum held a grand opening event as part of its ongoing investment in the city. The event, which took place on August 7, 2026, was attended by hundreds of current and potential drivers along with their families. This marks a milestone for Zum in the city as it prepares for the upcoming school year. The event was hosted in Philadelphia and showcased Zum's dedication to modern student transportation solutions.

data.title: CORRECTING and REPLACING The Modern Data Company Achieves TX-RAMP Level 2 Certification for DataOS
data.description: SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--In a release dated August 3, 2026, it was announced that the Texas Cyber Command (TXCC) has achieved TX-RAMP Level 2 certification for DataOS. This certification allows Texas agencies to procure DataOS and demonstrates The Modern Data Company's dedication to providing secure, governed, and AI-ready public-sector data. The Modern Data Company is the creator of DataOS, and this certification marks a significant milestone in their commitment to serving the public sector.

data.title: THE DOLPHIN COMPANY PROVIDES UPDATE FOLLOWING DELAWARE BANKRUPTCY COURT RULING
data.description: In a recent development, The Dolphin Company revealed that the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware dismissed the motion to terminate Chapter 11 proceedings, consequently affirming the continuation of operations under the current management. This decision was announced on August 7, 2026, in Cancun, Mexico. The court's determination signals a pivotal moment for the company, as it navigates through financial restructuring. The news underscores the ongoing efforts to address bankruptcy concerns and reinforces the commitment to reorganize under existing leadership. This significant decision marks a crucial step forward in the company's journey through the Chapter 11 process.

data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia on August 7, 2026, Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSX-V: WHN) (OTCQB: WTHVF) (FRA: 1W5) disclosed that, in accordance with their Stock Option Plan endorsed by shareholders at the June 24, 2026 Annual General Meeting, the company has awarded 300,000 incentive stock options to Officers.

data.title: Kate Mihevc Edwards, DPT Launches RunSource, an Expert-Filtered Running Health App for Injured Runners
data.description: A recently launched mobile application is offering access to over 40 verified running medicine experts and AI-driven running health advice to casual runners across the country. The service is priced at $14.99 per month and users can utilize their Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for payment through TruMed. The app was introduced in Atlanta on August 7, 2026, and is spearheaded by Kate Mihevc Edwards, a Doctor of Physical Therapy.

data.title: AIxCrypto Holdings Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
data.description: RoboShare, a new on-demand robot sharing and matchmaking platform, was successfully launched at Automate 2026 on June 22. It has been designated as the top operating priority for the second half of 2026. Operating expenses have decreased significantly by 32% sequentially following the introduction of RoboShare. This innovative platform aims to revolutionize the way robots are utilized, functioning as an "Uber plus Turo for robots."

data.title: MARKSMEN ANNOUNCES PROPOSED PRIVATE PLACEMENT
data.description: On August 7, 2026, Marksmen Energy Inc. in Calgary, Alberta, announced its intention to conduct a non-brokered private placement of a maximum of 10,000,000 common shares at a price of $0.12 per share. This offering aims to generate total gross proceeds of up to $1,200,000, with a potential additional $180,000 from an over-allotment option. The company may also pay a cash finder's fee of up to 8% of the gross proceeds (equivalent to a maximum of $96,000) to registered dealers involved in the Offering. There is no specified minimum amount for the Offering.

data.title: MONTERA INFRASTRUCTURE SUPPORTS GOVERNOR ABBOTT'S STANDARDS FOR RESPONSIBLE DATA CENTER GROWTH IN TEXAS
data.description: Montera Infrastructure, an engineering-focused company specializing in hyperscale data centers, reaffirmed its dedication to transparency, responsible resource management, and ensuring long-term protection for Texas communities and ratepayers. Montera Infrastructure's primary focus remains on ensuring the sustainability of its operations while meeting the growing demands for data services.
